# scripts/license-allowlist.txt
#
# First-party / generated-in-house assets that need NO third-party license.
# Read by scripts/resolve-license.sh. One repo-relative path per line.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Listing a path here is an explicit owner assertion that the asset was
# authored in-house by Damned Designs Studio (or generated by our own
# pipeline). It is NOT a fabricated upstream license. If any entry below turns
# out to be third-party work, REMOVE it from this list and add a real license
# note (a LICENSES.md manifest entry or a sidecar <name>.license file) instead.
#
# Third-party fonts are NOT listed here — they are covered by the manifest at
# apps/studio/src/assets/fonts/LICENSES.md and are validated against it.
